format: HTML with embedded JavaScript and Polymer component definition
description: This file defines a custom Polymer web component `<flatiron-director>` used for client-side routing. It imports the Polymer library and a minified director.js library, and manages route changes through properties and observers, integrating the director.js routing library into a Polymer component.

classes.name: flatiron-director
classes.description: A Polymer web component that wraps the director.js routing library for client-side routing in web applications.

methods.name: _routeChanged
methods.description: Observer method called when 'route' property changes; updates the URL hash if 'autoHash' is true and dispatches a custom event 'director-route'.

methods.name: ready
methods.description: Lifecycle method initializing the router, binding route change events, and setting the initial route.

methods.name: _router
methods.description: Getter that initializes and returns a singleton instance of the director.js Router.
